worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.summary: Whirl your fists to send a ground-hugging wave of vacuum: no contact, settled on Special Attack, sweeping every foe along a corridor while dragging them back toward you. The user does not move - the only ranged and special move of the family. Terrain cuts the wave short, and an empty wave can still be cast. The wide form covers more bodies at a lighter hit, shorter reach and diluted suction.
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.use.0: Open from range and sweep a corridor
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.use.1: Drag a fleeing foe back into melee
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.use.2: Bunch scattered enemies together before a follow-up
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.description: A wave sweeps out from you along the aim as a corridor and never touches the target; each foe it catches is settled at most once for about %1$s special damage. The corridor is %2$s blocks wide on each side, and the first block on the centreline cuts off everything beyond it; the target's Special Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Push up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick; a landed hit drags the target about %3$s blocks toward you (lighter bodies are pulled further).
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.wide.on: Wide form: half-width times 1.6 and more bodies covered, but 0.8 damage, 0.85 reach, 0.7 suction, 4 ticks more cooldown and 1 tick more recovery.
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.wide.off: Focused form: a narrow, concentrated wave with full suction, longer reach and a faster recovery, for yanking one target in.
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.growth.0: At level %1$s the wave rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.vacuumwave.growth.1: At level %1$s the wave rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s.
On: half-width times 1.6 and more bodies covered, but 0.8 damage, 0.85 reach, 0.7 suction, 4 ticks more cooldown and 1 tick more recovery. Off: a narrow concentrated wave with full suction, longer reach and a faster recovery.
It only pushes a wave at targets within this distance; it is a ranged move, so larger values commit sooner.
On: a target that is escaping ranks higher so the wave drags it back. Off: rank it as an ordinary ranged candidate.
